title: Exact-order payable assessment domain

decision.boundary: Represent one versioned caller-supplied commercial payable assessment against one exact FOOD-005E physical-order version. The domain derives amountDue from the exact historical merchandise subtotal plus explicit charge adjustments minus explicit credit adjustments.
whyNow: FOOD-005E preserves exact pre-payment order merchandise truth but no final payable amount.
FOOD-005F electronic payment confirmation is evidence only and explicitly does not establish paid-in-full truth.
FOOD-005I cash payment evidence is evidence only and explicitly does not establish paid-in-full truth.
Sales-tax review currently classifies product review state/conclusion but does not calculate a tax rate or tax amount.
A payable assessment is therefore required before any future payment reconciliation can compare received/confirmed money against an exact amount due.
decision.notATaxEngine: FOOD-005J does not infer taxable status, select a jurisdiction, choose a rate, calculate tax, or prove legal tax compliance. Any tax amount must arrive as an explicit caller-supplied charge adjustment from a future trusted policy/service.
decision.notAFeeEngine: FOOD-005J does not decide delivery radius, delivery pricing, meetup pricing, service fees, tips, discounts, rewards or promotions. Such amounts, if used later, must be explicitly supplied by trusted upstream policy as adjustments.
decision.notReconciliation: FOOD-005J consumes no electronic or cash payment evidence and does not establish paid, paid-in-full, overpaid or partially-paid truth.
decision.notFulfillment: FOOD-005J grants no reservation acceptance, preparation, scheduling, dispatch, delivery or handoff authority.
decision.notAccounting: FOOD-005J is commercial payable assessment truth, not revenue recognition, tax payable, bookkeeping, settlement or ledger truth.

versioning.newOrderVersion: A different physical-order version requires a different payable-assessment identity.

order.snapshot: Exact merchandiseSubtotal copied as historical context.

shape.reference: Opaque caller-supplied bounded semantic reference unique within the assessment version.
shape.money: Canonical FoodMoney in the exact order currency.

adjustments.semantics: No tax/fee/discount/reward semantics are inferred from adjustment references.

amountDue.currency: Must remain the order merchandise currency.

assessment.meaning: Caller assertion/provenance only. Pure domain does not authenticate assessor or source.

invariants: amountDue is derived, not trusted from caller input
credits may reduce amountDue to zero but never below zero
all adjustment money uses the exact merchandise currency

future.reconciliation: A later service/domain may bind one exact payable-assessment version plus trusted FOOD-005F and/or FOOD-005I evidence to derive payment status without mutating any source history.
future.checkout: A future trusted checkout service chooses which exact payable-assessment version is currently usable; existence alone grants no readiness.
future.policy: Tax, fulfillment-fee, discount and other policy engines may later produce explicit adjustments without changing FOOD-005J arithmetic semantics.
